Crypto christmas everyone!

```
O protocol bright, the chain is softly growing
A dawn of blocks in cryptographic light
Long lay the code in silence, waiting, knowing
Till proof was found and trust was born tonight
A spark of math, a ledger shared forever
No king nor crown, just consensus agreed
Hope took its form in hashes bound together
And value flowed where borders couldn’t lead
🎶
Hold on your keys
The mainnet is live now
Hold on your keys
Your trust is verified
Behold the blocks
In sequence unbroken
Oh chain divine
Oh chain decentralized
🎶
Led by the nodes through networks wide and open
No single hand commands the truth we see
The miners toil, their honest work is spoken
In bits that guard our sovereignty
No gates of gold, no vaults that must be trusted
The power rests where users choose to stand
A system born where old control was busted
A future held in everyone’s own hand
🎶
Stand by the chain
Let no fear deceive you
Stand by the chain
The ledger does not lie
Oh dawn secure
Of trustless tomorrow
Oh chain divine
Oh chain that cannot die
🎶
```
